body:
V9 is frozen after the independent video-admission review found one deeper authority blocker.

A complete self-consistent packet payload plus receipt can prove content integrity but cannot prove that an admitted decoder ran. Recomputed IDs catch mismatch and substitution; they do not distinguish a caller-authored whole receipt from an adapter-issued one.

The narrow V10 repair now states:
1. C1 may mint pure exact-rescale outcomes and only explicitly synthetic fixture-scoped packet outcomes.
2. C1 fixture packet outcomes cannot become runtime evidence or enter a production NarrativeSourceAtlas.
3. Every runtime decoder record remains draft in C1, even with internally consistent checksums and IDs.
4. D0 alone may mint runtime packet/extractor provenance through an admitted adapter-owned join to an orchestrator-issued invocation, exact result digest, terminal receipt, and append-only build-journal entry.
5. Generic codec replay remains draft; issuance authority is not a serializable caller tag.
6. The decisive court contrasts a self-consistent forged whole receipt with the adapter-emitted issued receipt and includes the lawful join positive control.

This preserves the C1 no-decoder ceiling and makes content identity, receipt integrity, and observation authority three separate claims. Exact component-ledger and video-admission re-reviews are underway.
